title: Shift coherence of normalized derived scalar unit
statement: For abelian categories B and B' with derived categories, exact additive functors E:B to B' and U:B' to B [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor], and an adjunction between their canonical exact derived functors, suppose a family of complex morphisms eta_K:K to UEK commutes with integer shifts and the derived adjunction unit is Q(eta_K) under the canonical factorization comparisons. Then the adjunction commutes with integer shifts, including its unit and counit. No separate naturality hypothesis on the family is needed: the derived unit provides naturality after Q.

proof.text: Precompose the derived unit by Q and compose with the canonical factorization comparison. Its components are Q(eta_K). The assumed complex shift equation and shift naturality of Q give shift compatibility of this natural transformation.
The exact-functor factorization comparisons respect shifts. Substitute the derived-unit normalization to obtain the shift equation on every localized complex.
Faithfulness of precomposition by localization gives the unit shift equation on the derived category. The adjunction triangle identities give the counit shift equation.

theorem scalarLocalization_unit_commShift
    {B B' : Type*} [Category B] [Category B'] [Abelian B] [Abelian B']
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} B] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} B']
    (E : B ⥤ B') [E.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits E] [PreservesFiniteColimits E]
    (U : B' ⥤ B) [U.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits U] [PreservesFiniteColimits U]
    (adj : E.mapDerivedCategory ⊣ U.mapDerivedCategory)
    (η : ∀ K : CochainComplex B ℤ, K ⟶
      (E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
    (hη : ∀ K, adj.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
      U.mapDerivedCategory.map (E.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K) ≫
      U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (η K))
    (hshift : ∀ (K : CochainComplex B ℤ) (k : ℤ), η (K⟦k⟧) ≫
      ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).commShiftIso k
        ).hom.app K = (η K)⟦k⟧') : adj.CommShift ℤ
